content.description: The content of the animal lesson, potentially in markdown or HTML format.

CropTracking.title: CropTracking
CropTracking.description: Represents data for tracking a specific crop.

cropType.description: Type of crop being tracked (e.g., maize, beans).

AnimalTracking.title: AnimalTracking
AnimalTracking.description: Represents data for tracking a specific animal.

id.description: Unique identifier for the animal tracking record.

tagId.description: The unique tag or identifier for the animal.

animalType.description: Type of animal being tracked (e.g., cow, goat).

healthStatus.description: Current health status of the animal.

growthMetrics.description: Measurements of the animal's growth (e.g., weight, height).

locationLatitude.description: Latitude of the animal's current location.

locationLongitude.description: Longitude of the animal's current location.

feedingSchedule.description: Structured data for animal feeding schedules.

timesPerDay.description: How many times a day the animal is fed.

vaccinationSchedule.description: Structured data for animal vaccination schedules.

nextVaccinationAt.description: Timestamp for the next scheduled vaccination.

Reminder.title: Reminder
Reminder.description: Represents a reminder for a specific task.

task.description: Description of the task to be reminded about.

dueDate.description: Date and time when the reminder should trigger.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the reminder has been completed.

Advice.title: Advice
Advice.description: Represents a piece of saved AI-generated advice for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the advice record.

cropType.description: The crop type for which the advice was generated.

growthStage.description: The growth stage for which the advice was generated.

recommendation.description: The AI-generated recommendation text, in markdown format.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the advice was saved.

id.description: Unique identifier for the diagnosis record.

diagnosis.description: The AI-generated diagnosis text, in markdown format.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the diagnosis was saved.

Device.description: Represents a user's device for push notifications.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the device was registered.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure data isolation per user, simplify security rules, and optimize query performance. We leverage path-based ownership for user-specific data and structural segregation to maintain a homogeneous security posture across collections. The design prioritizes Authorization Independence, ensuring that security rules can be evaluated without requiring `get()` calls to parent documents. This independence is achieved through data denormalization, specifically by including the 'userId' in all documents within the user-owned collections.

*   **User Data Isolation:**  A `UserProfile` document is now stored at `/users/{userId}`. All other user-specific data (CropTracking, AnimalTracking, Reminders, and Advice) are stored under subcollections of this user document. This ensures that only the authenticated user can access their data.
*   **Authorization Independence:** By including `userId` in all CropTracking, AnimalTracking, and Reminder documents, security rules can validate ownership based solely on the document's data and the `request.auth.uid`, without needing to perform expensive `get()` operations to parent documents. This allows atomic operations and simplifies debugging.
*   **Lessons:** CropLesson and AnimalLesson are stored in separate collections (`/crop_lessons` and `/animal_lessons` respectively). This structural segregation is used as those lessons will be available to every user (no user id).
*   **QAPs:** List operations are secured because each collection either contains only user-owned data (enforced by path-based ownership) or globally accessible data (lessons). Rules ensure users can only list documents under their own user ID.
